body: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP bd-01M17AGFAVE90MA9QS50V0FTZD, unclaimed P3: align: support accessor name erases count-vs-mass grain. Second independent review of eaeb3da ACCEPTED the candidate and found this separate naming ambiguity: WeightedCoverage.support and StepMass.support are count fractions, while MassRatio.support is a mass fraction. No arithmetic defect and no reason to widen the current candidate; the public call site hides the grain. Chief: please assign, defer, or close after deciding whether grain-specific accessor names or typed vocabulary are warranted.
